# Packages API

12 endpoints. Request and response schemas are described on the [schemas page](schemas.md); the other tags are listed in the [API index](README.md).

## Endpoints

### `GET /api/v1/packages/recent`

Recent packages

The most recently published package versions across the repositories the caller can read, newest first. A version with several files (architectures, classifiers, distributions) appears once. Proxy cache entries are not publications and are left out. The server records no publisher, so created_by_name is never set; mine=true narrows the list to the repositories the caller can write to.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mine` | query | boolean | no | true keeps the repositories the caller has write permission on |
| `limit` | query | integer | no | Maximum entries (default 10, at most 50). Minimum: 1. Maximum: 50. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Recent package versions | `application/json`: object |
| `400` | Invalid mine | - |

Fields of the `200` response (`application/json`):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `packages` | array of [RecentPackage](schemas.md#recentpackage) | yes | - |

### `GET /api/v1/repositories/{name}/packages`

List packages in repository

List all packages in a specific repository

**Security:** `bearerAuth` or `cookieAuth` or .

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `page` | query | integer | no | Minimum: 1. |
| `limit` | query | integer | no | Minimum: 1. Maximum: 100. |
| `q` | query | string | no | Only list rows whose listed name or version contains this text (case-insensitive, at most 200 characters). Maximum length: 200. |
| `sort` | query | string | no | Row order: newest first (created, the default) or by name and version (name). One of: `created`, `name`. |
| `format` | query | string | no | Only list packages of this format |
| `package_name` | query | string | no | Only list rows whose listed package name equals this value exactly (all versions of one package) |
| `group` | query | string | no | package returns one entry per package (format and name) instead of one per file: its latest version, version count, latest size and the scan state of the latest version. total then counts packages. The q, format and package_name filters apply to the rows before they are grouped. One of: `package`. |
| `flagged` | query | boolean | no | With group=package, true keeps the packages whose latest version has a critical or high vulnerability, a secret finding or a quarantined scan result. Rejected without group=package. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | List of packages: one entry per file (PackageFile), or one per package (PackageGroup) with group=package | `application/json`: object |
| `400` | Invalid sort, group, flagged or q | - |
| `404` | Repository not found | - |

Fields of the `200` response (`application/json`):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | - |
| `packages` | array of any | no | - |
| `page` | integer | no | - |
| `total` | integer | no | - |

### `GET /api/v1/repositories/{name}/packages/{id}`

Get a package version

One package version, by the row id of the package listing: the metadata its format stores, its declared dependencies and the files of the version. Requires read access to the repository. Dependencies are returned for npm (dependencies, devDependencies, peerDependencies, optionalDependencies), cargo, nuget (kind is the target framework), rubygems, conda, deb (Depends, Pre-Depends), rpm (requires) and go (go.mod require directives); the other formats do not store them server-side and return an empty list. Metadata holds only what the format's table stores: for pypi, helm, maven, docker and conan there are no declared dependencies, and docker layers or the image config are not part of the response.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | Repository name |
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | Row id from the package listing |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | The package version | `application/json`: [PackageDetail](schemas.md#packagedetail) |
| `403` | No read access to the repository | - |
| `404` | Repository or package not found (a package of another repository is not found either) | - |

### `POST /api/v1/repositories/{name}/uploads`

Start a presigned upload

Hosted raw repositories on any storage backend with a staging area: S3-compatible and GCS (presigned URLs), Azure (SAS URLs), and the filesystem and OCI registry backends (short-lived HMAC-signed URLs served by this server, which need `baseUrl` to be set). Returns a short-lived presigned PUT URL to a staging object; upload the bytes directly to it, then call the complete endpoint. Files above 5 GiB (up to 5 TiB) must set `multipart`: the response then carries the part plan instead of a URL, and each part URL comes from the parts endpoint. Requires write permission on the repository and on the path. The response carries a bearer credential and is sent with Cache-Control: no-store. A user may have at most storage.presignMaxPendingUploads uploads outstanding (not completed, not expired).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: [PresignedUploadRequest](schemas.md#presigneduploadrequest)

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Upload target | `application/json`: [PresignedUpload](schemas.md#presignedupload) |
| `400` | Invalid path, size, part size or sha256 (code invalid_size also when a size above 5 GiB lacks `multipart`, or is too large for a single upload on Azure), or the repository is not a hosted raw repository | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `401` | Authentication required | - |
| `403` | Write permission denied | - |
| `404` | Repository not found | - |
| `429` | Too many outstanding uploads for this user (retry after the Retry-After header) | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `501` | The storage backend does not support presigned uploads | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `POST /api/v1/repositories/{name}/uploads/{id}/abort`

Abort a presigned upload

Discards an upload that will not be completed: the staging object, the parts uploaded so far and the upload record. Only the creator of the upload or an administrator may abort it. Abandoned uploads are also swept automatically after they expire.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | The upload was discarded | - |
| `400` | Invalid request | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `401` | Authentication required | - |
| `403` | Write permission denied, or the caller is neither the creator of the upload nor an administrator | - |
| `404` | Repository or upload not found (or expired and swept) | - |
| `409` | Code upload_completed: the upload is already completed. Code upload_in_progress: a complete is running (retry after the Retry-After header) | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `501` | The storage backend does not support presigned uploads | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `POST /api/v1/repositories/{name}/uploads/{id}/complete`

Complete a presigned upload

Verifies that the staged object has the declared size and sha256, moves it to its content-addressed key, records the artifact (overwriting an existing path, like a raw PUT) and deletes the staging object. Only the creator of the upload or an administrator may complete it. The server reads the object back (up to 5 TiB) in a detached job (30 minutes plus about one second per 20 MiB, at most 6 hours) that survives a client disconnect; the read and the move are conditional on the object version seen at verification, so an object re-uploaded in between is refused. The call is idempotent: the first success returns 201, a retry returns 200 with the same body, and a retry while a verification is running returns 409 upload_in_progress. On a size or sha256 mismatch, or when the object changed during verification, the staging object and the upload are discarded and nothing is recorded. The repository's storage quota is enforced (507 quota_exceeded: the upload stays pending, nothing is recorded, and completing again after freeing space works); license and secret scanning are not applied, as for a raw PUT.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | - |
| `force` | query | boolean | no | Administrators only: `true` overwrites an existing file of a repository with `immutable_releases`. Ignored for everyone else. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | The upload was already completed; the original result | `application/json`: [PresignedUploadResult](schemas.md#presigneduploadresult) |
| `201` | Artifact recorded | `application/json`: [PresignedUploadResult](schemas.md#presigneduploadresult) |
| `400` | The repository is not a hosted raw repository | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `401` | Authentication required | - |
| `403` | Write permission denied, or the caller is neither the creator of the upload nor an administrator | - |
| `404` | Repository or upload not found (or expired and swept) | - |
| `409` | Code upload_missing: nothing has been uploaded to the upload URL yet. Code upload_in_progress: another complete is verifying this upload (retry after the Retry-After header). Code upload_incomplete: a part of a multipart upload is missing or has the wrong size (the message names the part numbers; upload them and call complete again). Code upload_changed: the staged object was overwritten during verification; the upload was discarded. Code immutable_release: the path already exists in a repository with `immutable_releases`; nothing was recorded and the upload stays pending (retry with `force=true` as an administrator) | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `410` | The upload expired | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `422` | Size or sha256 does not match the declaration; the upload was discarded | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `501` | The storage backend does not support presigned uploads | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `507` | Code quota_exceeded: the repository's storage quota would be exceeded; nothing was recorded and the upload stays pending | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `POST /api/v1/repositories/{name}/uploads/{id}/parts`

Sign the parts of a multipart upload

Returns presigned PUT URLs for up to 100 parts of a multipart upload, each for exactly the returned size. Call it as often as needed (URLs live as long as the single-upload URL, and every call extends the upload's deadline), PUT the parts in any order and in parallel, then call complete. A part may be re-uploaded. The response carries bearer credentials and is sent with Cache-Control: no-store. Only the creator of the upload or an administrator may call it.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | - |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: [PresignedPartsRequest](schemas.md#presignedpartsrequest)

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Part upload targets | `application/json`: [PresignedParts](schemas.md#presignedparts) |
| `400` | Code invalid_part_numbers: empty, duplicate, more than 100 or out-of-range part numbers. Code not_multipart: the upload is a single upload | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `401` | Authentication required | - |
| `403` | Write permission denied, or the caller is neither the creator of the upload nor an administrator | - |
| `404` | Repository or upload not found (or expired and swept) | - |
| `409` | Code upload_completed: the upload is already completed | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `410` | The upload expired | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `501` | The storage backend does not support multipart uploads | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
